confidence_notes: June citywide prices support the meal, cappuccino and draft beer estimates for July. Cocktail and wine prices vary by venue, so both estimates use local premiums over draft beer. Lodging prices are model estimates. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Buenos-Aires), [Expatistan](https://www.expatistan.com/es/costo-de-vida/buenos-aires?currency=USD), [Puchero menu](https://puchero.com.ar/Cartas/Espanol/Carta-Puchero.pdf)
comparable_city_reasoning: Santiago provides a broad lodging benchmark as another large Southern Cone capital with year-round visitors. The estimates reflect Buenos Aires' extensive budget lodging supply and July winter demand.
